name: Volume.at Events
notes: Server-rendered per-day agenda at /events/<YYYY-MM-DD>/, ~4-7 days per fetch; scraper walks forward advancing past the last date header seen (dates with zero events are skipped in the markup, so a fixed step would miss/duplicate). No event time or street address in the listing, only city name (district always null, city only set when address text is literally 'Wien'). Cancelled events keep a literal 'abgesagt' badge in the title, not a CSS class (item__title--canceled is present on every single item regardless of status and is NOT a cancellation signal).
